g.text: LW01 — player profiles change both survival and narrative freedom

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717d

g.text: Across the 27 configured profiles, win probability and path entropy rise together (descriptive r = 0.83).

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717d

g.text: Each point is one profile. The correlation describes the complete factorial design; it is not a population estimate or a causal effect.
